name: Possession Scroll Tales
source:
The wizard Eman Looc has just completed his newest spell, and he’s sending it to the town of Old Re-Cipe to spark new and exciting stories. Many different twists and styles can unfold depending on who the it ends up with, and Looc can't wait to tell you all about what happens when someone acquires the, Possession Scroll.

[From [url=https://tfgames.site/?module=viewgame&id=3480]tfgames.site[/url]]
translation:
巫师Eman Looc刚刚完成了他的最新咒语，他将其发送到Old Re-Cipe镇，以激发新的激动人心的故事。根据它的最终结局，许多不同的曲折和风格会展开，而Looc迫不及待地想告诉你当有人获得占有卷轴时会发生什么。

[来自[url=https://tfgames.site/?module=viewgame&id=3480]tfgames.site[/url]]
